scope: Exact reviewed sanitized Airship V10 asset only: creator layout with required assembly and fuel preparation. Fresh disposable flat world, actual Create placement and normal Physics Assembler, unpaused Sable physics and original typewriter controller callbacks. Both trials add the same Honey Glue selection via its normal server handler; original rotor Super Glue is preserved. Creative observer camera follows the craft; no ship pose/velocity/force injection and no passenger or authenticated multiplayer acceptance. Create strips runtime engine fuel; both trials attempt identical Creative Blaze Cake item interactions to reproduce the source build's infinite superheated fuel, with per-click states recorded and verified before assembly. Public build is not distributed with this harness.
evidenceNote: Compact record; individual fuel clicks, drivetrain NBT dumps and five-tick motion samples remain in the ignored local raw report.
